review: Barber of Lamanchaland Outis is a Bleed Identity who scales higher with Bleed damage dealt during the fight. Her placement can go higher, depending on her synergy with other Bloodfiend Identities in the future. First, let’s talk about her gimmick. Each time a unit takes Bleed damage, it's stored as Bloodfeast. Whenever Outis uses her Skill 1 or 2, she will consume a certain amount of Bloodfeast to increase her Blood-tinged Scissorblades. Blood-tinged Scissorblades have 3 stages, with different buffs on stages 2 and 3. Stage 2 grants 2 Offense Level and 1 Defense Level down per 5 stacks, with Stage 3 removing the Defense Level Down demerit. Outside of offense buff, Blood-tinged Scissorblades are also used to enhance her Skill 3. Thus, the general playstyle for Barber Outis is straightforward.
